text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has ended. We completed all 
kinds of special training to awaken Meisho 
Doto's ambition. And then—!

In the end, nothing took root at all... 
Meisho Doto's kindness was truly deep-dyed 
and unwavering...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... How should I put this... I just 
can't bring myself to push anyone else 
aside, no matter what...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm gonna study! This autumn, I'll 
be hitting the books~. For the sake of the 
future that's to come.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I just feel like if I follow 
Opera O-san and Ayabe-san, everything will 
be all right.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There's Opera O-san, always full of 
confidence, and Ayabe-san, always looking 
up to the sky...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Those two are always amazing, and always 
right. If I follow them and treat them 
like my teachers, surely...!
choice_data_list: Can my heart get stronger too?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I believe in them. After all, I 
love them both so much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, won't you believe in me? Um, 
just a little bit...
choice_data_list: Got it. I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! There's no doubt that as long as 
you believe in me, everything will be 
fine! Haa-hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
As long as it doesn't cause me any 
trouble, I don't really mind.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: As long as the two of you are with me, I—!

The ceiling hindering Meisho Doto's growth 
remains as heavy as ever. This autumn, 
let's learn 'the resolve to run' from two 
of her peers.
